name: @org/shared
description: Shared RN core (theme, api client, auth store, constants, types, utils, components, auth screens) for the two apps. Pure JS/TS. Native modules (react, react-native, AsyncStorage, geolocation, vector-icons, crashlytics, axios, zustand) are provided by the HOST app and resolved from it by Metro (resolveRequest pins in the host metro.config.js) and by tsc (host tsconfig paths). Intentionally declares NO react/react-native peerDependencies: this is a private workspace package, and declaring them makes npm try to satisfy the peer at the monorepo root (where the web packages pin an older react), which ERESOLVE-conflicts with the RN react stack.
